goal: In Task Managers, the Repository choice lists git repositories (OWNER/NAME from the checkout's origin, with its path) instead of the configured nicknames, and a selected directory is checked against the chosen repository when it is selected, not only when an agent starts.
constraints: The config key stays the stored id, form value, event payload and --repo value; no migration of stored events.
A configured path that is not a git repository is not offered and is reported as a configuration problem.
A directory corresponds to a repository only when it is that checkout or a linked worktree of it; a separate clone with the same origin is refused with a message that says so.
A label never carries URL credentials.
Preserve the uncommitted turn-context edits in the working tree.

non_goals.description: Do not change event storage or migrations.
Do not discover repositories outside task-managers.json.
Do not touch the turn-context work in progress.

acceptance.criterion: check reports repositories with git identity, label and problems for non-git paths
Repository options show the git repository label and path with the config key as value; a non-git entry is not offered; a directory outside the repository is refused when the association is saved
Agent start refusals name the git repository and identify a separate clone
The audit service suite still passes
